feature_completion_policy: Partial catalog entries identify working subsets, not fulfilled acceptance criteria. No feature is claimed verified in the full catalog.

phases.available: Qt-free core, CPU reference renderer, locked infrastructure dependencies, bounded OpenToonz source audit and save failure tests.
phases.remaining: Renderer comparison, successful reuse extraction/build audit, fill/deformation spikes, device matrix and production budgets.

phases.available: Native English QML shell, CMake modules, commands, immutable snapshots, undo/redo and validation. Integrated resizable timing/curve workspace and selection-owned object/layer Properties. Shared compact controls, optional curve numeric fields and a draggable workspace divider with dynamic bounds. Typed layer-transform property addresses now distinguish rest, authored keys and evaluated values with atomic edits.
phases.remaining: Docking/workspace persistence, configurable shortcuts, full accessibility, scalable resource/cache protocols and cross-platform qualification.

phases.available: Mouse pencil, exposures, onion skin, playback, save/reopen, 48-frame 1080p PNG export, and atomic registered transparent PNG parts/numbered-sequence intake.
phases.remaining: Full phase feature acceptance and animator-led workflow checks; large-project behavior and all fixture gates.

phases.available: Synchronized virtualized timeline/Xsheet, create/hold/clear exposures, insert/remove frames and navigate drawings. Multi-layer range clipboard, independent drawing paste, key paste, cycles, ones/twos/threes, overwrite retiming, Alt-drag moves, markers and bounded Xsheet PDF export. Clear removes selected exposures and pose keys together. Timeline/Xsheet diamonds can be dragged directly; Keys mode adds poses by double-click, with adjustable timeline cell width.
phases.remaining: Frame annotations/thumbnails, advanced onion/tracing controls, paperless workflows and artist acceptance.

phases.available: Sampled vector strokes, approximate eraser, primitives, single-stroke selection, point editing/smoothing, stable palette IDs and shape recoloring. Rectangular whole-stroke multi-selection, move/duplicate/delete, flips and quarter turns preserve editable geometry, swatch and art-layer IDs. On-canvas scale/rotation handles with live previews and explicit selected-vector properties. Thin vectors have a constant screen-space hit margin respecting art order; point dragging previews the complete stroke, with contextual tool/handle cursors. Pencil/polygon points can be inserted on segments by double-click and deleted individually while preserving identity, pressure interpolation and minimum geometry. Shift/Alt add/subtract whole vectors by click or marquee, with sparse membership, individual selection bounds, tool-switch preservation and identity-safe duplication. Whole-footprint vector lasso with modifiers, select all/invert, cross-scene vector cut/copy/paste, local nudges, alignment/distribution, art-layer stacking, batch styles, corner-aware smoothing, pressure-aware simplification, constrained lines/primitives and drawing-local grid/snapping.
phases.remaining: Region topology/fill, analytic erasing, Bezier/contour/width editors, presets/textures, advanced guides, partial contour and raster lasso selection, geometry combining and production-scale optimization.

phases.available: Sparse immutable 15-bit premultiplied tiles, libmypaint ink/soft/dry/smudge/eraser presets, pressure input, cancellable gestures, shared preview/export and compressed project resources. Brush opacity and rectangular pixel selection with integer move/duplicate/delete, flips and lossless quarter turns, alpha-safe overlap and guarded canvas bounds. Free scale/rotation preview and commit using nearest-neighbor sampling with transparent surroundings.
phases.remaining: Brush texture/import/preset management, lasso/soft masks, high-quality resampling and transform performance qualification, resolution changes, production workload and physical-device qualification.

phases.available: Layer transform keys with linear/held/smooth interpolation, inherited transforms/opacity, explicit Setup/Animate and Auto key, key navigation/state, editable pose-channel graph and key-only multi-layer retiming with collision rejection. Curves stay in the main workspace; timeline/Xsheet range-end dragging stretches timing. Animate (A) records layer poses directly with move/scale/rotation handles and an initial anchor. Per-channel normalized Bezier handles, overshoot presets, graph key creation and a evaluated canvas trajectory share evaluation with export. All motion defaults to normalized combined channels with in-place channel selection, square-key editing, linked/unlinked easing handles, a full-pose retiming lane and time zoom/panning. Shared sparse pose-key selection, direct group drag/Alt-duplicate, right-edge timing stretch, keyboard nudges/delete and local-unit motion copy/paste with collision protection and atomic undo. Animate Path mode edits individual pose positions directly on the canvas, with fixed drawing references, animated-parent mapping, screen-axis constraints, sampled pose insertion and atomic preview/undo. Batch full-pose interpolation/easing and append-key-block repetition preserve poses, reject collisions atomically and extend duration with one undo. A compact Pose menu copies layer transforms, pastes full or position/rotation/scale/opacity/pivot channels, mirrors horizontal/vertical scale and resets setup/keyed poses.
phases.remaining: Independent channel keys, linked/free analytic tangents, separate spatial paths and velocity, multi-layer/channel-mask batched editing and world-space motion retargeting, cameras and multiplane evaluation.

phases.available: Exact rational frame-to-sample arithmetic has a domain test; no audio playback.
phases.remaining: Audio decode/timeline/waveform/sync, mouth mapping/manual lip correction, optional detection, media policies, FFmpeg adapter and video output.

phases.available: Parented layers, pivots, independent duplicates and linked drawing clones.
phases.remaining: Character/part identity, production cut-out tools, named substitutions and masked poses, Quick Rig, declarative controls, asset/template library, instance-safe mappings and animator validation.
Curve/bone/mesh deformation, constraints, binding/weights, deterministic solvers and reference fixtures.

phases.available: CPU layer painting is available; it is not a node compositor.
phases.remaining: Typed graph evaluation, node UI, masks/effects, ROI/cache scheduling, OCIO and alpha/color reference scenes.

phases.available: Saved revisions, recovery UX, English guide, regression tests and source CI are initial prerequisites. Format 1/2 migration backups, format 3 curve metadata and checked compressed media resources, explicit backed-up compaction and asynchronous recovery snapshots. Requested arm64 macOS preview now includes audited runtime dependencies, notices, matching source archives/recipes and verified ad-hoc signatures.
phases.remaining: All required journeys, remaining hardening, supported device/OS matrix, accessibility, reproducible release SBOM automation, clean-machine validation and Developer ID signed/notarized releases.

brush_benchmark.scope: Synthetic 4K engine and snapshot timing; not full input-to-display latency

drawing_selection.scope: Overlapping tile-boundary moves, shared untouched tiles, sparse transparency, source-over compositing, flips and four quarter turns, vector identity and art/palette preservation, undo and atomic rejection. Free affine transforms, transparent raster resampling and explicit vector-ID membership. Point insertion interpolates pressure and preserves metadata; deletion enforces minimum geometry and rejects analytic primitives. Sparse additive selection and zero-offset duplicate identity output preserve enclosed bystanders and raster media; outputs remain unpublished on rejected edits.

brush_opacity.scope: Coverage at zero/partial/full opacity; eraser works with transparent selected swatch.

visual_animation.scope: Bezier endpoint/overshoot/channel isolation/opacity and retiming; invalid handle rejection; schema 1/2 backup migration; thin-stroke picking at 0.1–10x with rotated nonuniform transforms; native pose and curve gestures. Full-pose retiming preserves values/easing, linked easing validates all channels, collisions reject atomically.
visual_animation.limitations: Synthetic mouse/tablet input; physical tablets, Linux/Windows qualification and production-scale performance pending.

key_blocks.scope: Sparse moves, proportional retiming, rounded/cross-key collisions, duplicates, local pose/pivot/easing clipboard transfer, locked edits, undo/redo and persistence. Native grouped input gestures and focus-safe shortcuts. Batch interpolation removes stale easing; full-pose outgoing presets and bounded repetition preserve gaps and reject collisions atomically.
key_blocks.limitations: Full poses on one selected layer. No world-space retargeting or channel masks; no production-size performance or physical-device qualification.

motion_path.scope: Direct X/Y key editing on evaluated canvas trajectories with atomic preview, parent-space mapping and fixed local references. Native hierarchy, view, insertion and persistence checks.
motion_path.limitations: Integer-frame sampled display. No independent spatial spline, path tangents, separate velocity, parent-key editing, dense-scene or physical-device qualification.

vector_authoring.scope: Cross-scene clipboard and swatches, explicit vector arrangement/stacking, batch style rejection, protected-corner smoothing, bounded pressure-aware simplification and concave whole-footprint lasso. Native authoring journey with Undo and persistence.
vector_authoring.limitations: Whole vectors only; clipboard is application-local; no raster lasso, partial contours, analytic topology or production-scale qualification.
